wholePhysicalScope: Measured OpenStreetMap outer and inner spectator boundaries, separate pavilion footprints and three components of the mapped playing field. Main stand offsets are sampled across the mapped envelope at two-degree intervals.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the stepped seating bowl, open outfield pavilions and light arrays. Near levels refine the concrete decks, risers, hexagonal boards and baseball diamond.
limitations: Unevaluated club interiors, advertising and scoreboard programs are omitted. Roof, mid-century exterior, concourse and riser details are schematic.
The bowl section and playing-field elevation use approximate exterior registration to the original USGS 3DEP field.
